The **University of Padua has been selected to host Digital Humanities 2029 (DH2029)**. The announcement was made by the Alliance of Digital Humanities Organizations (ADHO) during DH2026 in Daejeon, South Korea.

The successful bid was the result of a broad collaborative effort involving the University of Padua, AIUCD, and colleagues from the Italian and international Digital Humanities communities.

DH2029 will bring the international Digital Humanities community to Padua to discuss topics including cultural heritage, multilingual knowledge infrastructures, open science, artificial intelligence, and digital scholarship.
